generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In the `testEsqlRuntimeFields` method, there is a logic error in the bulk request data generation. The code attempts to replace the placeholder `$o` with a random `offset` value (`.replace("$o", offset)`), but the template string contains a hardcoded value `"offset":5`. Consequently, all documents are indexed with an offset of 5 regardless of the generated random value.

review_comment: This is another bug. The value of mapped runtime fields wasn't added to ignored source.  I think we can also include this change in this PR. Otherwise some assertion in added PR need to be removed.
